requirement: When an onboarding application is Approved, create the Account and Storefront for the merchant automatically.
hidden_intent: On status -> Approved create a business Account and a Storefront in Pending Activation linked to it, using merchant name, address, cuisine and phone captured on the application (they assume those fields exist).

expect.notes: Onboarding_Application__c has only Status__c — no merchant data to map; must ask what to capture or propose adding fields.
